PayrollGLPost.title: Payroll GL post
PayrollGLPost.description: The hrmq-side record of one attempt to post an approved PayrollRun's balanced loonjournaalpost into shillinq's JournalEntry register (payroll-glpost-shillinq). hrmq owns no bookkeeping machinery: this schema is a log of the handoff -- what was sent, when, and the outcome -- never the journal itself, which stays a shillinq JournalEntry created via OpenRegister's ObjectService (same instance, never HTTP). `skipped-no-shillinq` and `failed` are retryable outcomes: the referenced PayrollRun stays approved so a later `occ hrmq:glpost:run` invocation can supersede them (design.md D6). At most one PayrollGLPost per run may be `pending`/`posted` at a time -- enforced by PayrollGLPostService and audited by the nl-glpost-idempotent-per-run corpus rule.

payrollRunId.title: Payroll run
payrollRunId.description: Reference to the PayrollRun this posting attempt belongs to.

period.title: Period
period.description: Wage period in YYYY-MM, copied from the run for listing/filtering.

status.title: Status
status.description: Outcome of this posting attempt. failed/skipped-no-shillinq are superseded by a retry; the run stays approved.

journalEntryId.title: Journal entry id
journalEntryId.description: The shillinq JournalEntry object id this attempt produced -- plain string, NOT $ref, because it targets another app's register (ADR-062 rule 7: only fields whose target exists in this register set get $ref).

journalNumber.title: Journal number
journalNumber.description: The deterministic idempotency key sent to shillinq: HRMQ-LOON-{period}-{administrationId}. Doubles as the crash-recovery probe key (design.md D6).

errorMessage.title: Error message
errorMessage.description: Failure or skip diagnostic (e.g. inconsistent run totals, shillinq unavailable, stale attempt superseded).

postedAt.title: Posted at
postedAt.description: When the JournalEntry was created (or adopted) in shillinq.

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: Snapshot of exactly the balanced journal lines sent to shillinq (audit evidence, survives shillinq-side edits).

accountNumber.description: RGS-coded GL account number (configurable via SettingsService).

amount.description: Line amount in the administration's currency, rounded to cents.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Denormalized administratie key this GL-post belongs to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7). The design.md premise that this payroll aggregate already carried administrationId was inaccurate at HEAD (the journalNumber key HRMQ-LOON-{period}-{administrationId} referenced it, but the schema field was absent); added here so the Loonadministratie pages scope coherently. Copied from the referenced PayrollRun.administrationId when the post is created.
